title: The spectrum morphism of a field extension is quasi-compact
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. The structure morphism $p:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism].

source.place: Schemes, Lemma Tag 01K4 (quasi-compact iff inverse images of affine opens are quasi-compact); Spec K is affine, hence quasi-compact
